summary: The main article describes an organophotocatalytic method for the direct C-H difluoromethylation of heterocycles using sodium difluoromethane sulfonate and oxygen. It includes optimization tables, substrate scope figures for various heterocycles and bioactive molecules, and mechanistic studies.

items.heading: Fig. 1
items.caption: Construction of CF2H-containing heterocycles. a Examples of CF2H- bioactive molecules. b TBHP promoted direct difluoromethylation of heterocycles. c High-energy light promoted direct difluoromethylation of heterocycles. d Ag and K2S2O8 co-catalyzed direct difluoromethylation of heterocycles. e Cu and PQ co-catalyzed direct difluoromethylation of heterocycles. f Organic photoredox catalysis triggered direct difluoromethylation of heterocycles.
items.description: Overview of existing methods for difluoromethylation versus the newly developed organic photoredox approach.

items.heading: Table 1
items.caption: Investigation of the reaction conditions. a The reactions were carried out with 1a (0.2 mmol), CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.4 mmol), photocatalyst (2 mol%) in 1 mL solvent under two 3 W green LEDs irradiation at room temperature. b Isolated yield. c The photocatalyst loading was decreased to 1 mol%. d In the dark.
items.description: Optimization table screening various photocatalysts and solvents for the difluoromethylation of 1-methyl quinoxolin-2-one.

items.heading: Fig. 2
items.caption: Substrate scope of quinoxalin-2(1 H )-ones. Reaction conditions: 1 (0.2 mmol), CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.4 mmol), rose bengal (2 mol%) in 1 mL DMSO under two 3 W green LEDs irradiation at room temperature. Isolated yields based on 1 .
items.description: Displays the chemical structures and yields for the difluoromethylation of various substituted quinoxalin-2(1H)-ones.

items.heading: Fig. 3
items.caption: Substrate scope of heteroaromatics. Reaction conditions: 4 (0.1 mmol), CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.4 mmol), rose bengal (5 mol.%) in 1 mL DMSO under two 3 W green LEDs irradiation at room temperature. Isolated yields based on 4 . b With CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.4 mmol), rose bengal (2 mol%) in 1 mL DMSO.
items.description: Shows the scope of the reaction across different classes of heteroaromatics including pyrazines, indoles, and purines.

items.heading: Fig. 4
items.caption: Substrate scope of bioactive molecules. Reaction conditions: 4 (0.1 mmol), CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.4 mmol), rose bengal (5 mol%) in 1 mL DMSO under two 3 W green LEDs irradiation at room temperature. Isolated yields based on 4 . b With CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.4 mmol), rose bengal (2 mol%) in 1 mL DMSO. c Large scale with 2 mmol heteroarenes. d The minor regioisomeric position is labeled with the respective carbon atom number.
items.description: Demonstrates the late-stage difluoromethylation of complex bioactive molecules like caffeine, melatonin, and voriconazole.

items.heading: Fig. 5
items.caption: Site-selectivity study. a Regioselectivity for indoles. b Regioselectivity for 4-chloro-7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d] pyrimidine. c Regioselectivity for benzofuran. d Regioselectivity for thianaphthene. Reaction conditions: heterocycles (0.1 mmol), CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.4 mmol), rose bengal (5 mol%) in 1 mL DMSO under two 3 W green LEDs irradiation at room temperature. Isolated yields based on heterocycles. b The minor regioisomeric position is labeled with the respective carbon atom number.
items.description: Analyzes the regioselectivity of the difluoromethylation reaction on various heterocyclic scaffolds.

items.heading: Fig. 6
items.caption: Synthetic applications. a The reactions were carried out with 4 (0.1 mmol), CF2HSO2Na 2 (0.2 mmol), rose bengal (2 mol%) in 1 mL DMSO under sunlight irradiation at room temperature. b Cytotoxicity of compounds. i MCF-7 (human breast adenocarcinoma cells), ii HepG-2 (human liver hepatocellular carcinoma cells), iii HCT116 (human colorectal cancer cells), and iv Hela (human cervical carcinoma cells) were treated with various concentrations of each compound for 72 h. Cell death was then measured by using a CCK-8 assays ( n = 5, mean ± SD).
items.description: Presents sunlight-driven reaction results and biological activity data (IC50 values) for the synthesized product F2TDR against cancer cell lines.

items.heading: Fig. 7
items.caption: Mechanistic investigations. a Investigation on the effect of TEMPO. b Radical trapping with 1,1-diphenylethylene. c Investigation on the effect of oxygen. d Light/dark experiment. e Proposed reaction mechanism.
items.description: Details the control experiments and the proposed photoredox catalytic cycle for the difluoromethylation process.
